To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

an LCSA can be implemented in a business context by using a Product Sustainability Budget (i.e., the profit from a sustainability package) to enable product sustainability improvement despite of rising costs.

a sustainability package can be sold at a price premium of 0.4 to 1.7% and a product sustainability budget can be created that enables the decision for product sustainability measures despite of rising production costs.
the introduction of an LCSAs evaluation scheme on component-level in combination with the PSB could enable substantial product improvement even when costs rise.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how a company could increase its product sustainability and what the costs would be.
the question how to use LCSA results in the decision-making process of an automotive company.

the question: how can a company create a budget to improve product sustainability? We believe that this budget should be created based on the willingness-to-pay (or preference) for product sustainability and the profit of a product.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed concept of a Product Sustainability Budget should be tested in a business context.
the PSB is an effective instrument to enable product sustainability improvement measures in a business context.

the introduction of an LCSAs evaluation scheme on component and product level in combination with a Product Sustainability Budget could increase the use of product sustainability assessment results in decision-making and thus increase the use of sustainability assessment results in business contexts.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
LCSA can be used to support decision-making processes in a business context and that the PSB could be one way to do so.
the proposed LCSA framework and the PSB are a viable way to enable product sustainability improvement in a company.
the combination of LCSA and the PSB concept can be a valuable tool for companies to increase product sustainability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the proposed approach can support decision makers in the implementation of product sustainability improvement measures.
a product sustainability budget could be a valuable tool to support the integration of sustainability in business decision-making.
a PSB is a viable concept to increase the use LCSA results in business decision-making processes.
